<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>A traffic light controller with red, yellow, and green signals.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="pass_request">Request signal for pedestrians to cross the road.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">Count value of the internal counter.</output>
        <output id="red">Red signal indicating stop.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow signal indicating caution.</output>
        <output id="green">Green signal indicating go.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="idle">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s1_red">State 1 - Red.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s2_yellow">State 2 - Yellow.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s3_green">State 3 - Green.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="cnt" width_description="[7:0]" description="Internal counter for timing control."/>
        <register id="state" width_description="[1:0]" description="Current state of the traffic light controller."/>
        <register id="p_red" width_description="1" description="Next value for red signal."/>
        <register id="p_yellow" width_description="1" description="Next value for yellow signal."/>
        <register id="p_green" width_description="1" description="Next value for green signal."/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= 'd0;
                p_red <= 0;
                p_yellow <= 0;
                p_green <= 0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    'd0: begin // idle
                        p_red <= 0;
                        p_yellow <= 0;
                        p_green <= 0;
                        state <= 'd1;
                    end
                    'd1: begin // s1_red
                        p_red <= 1;
                        p_yellow <= 0;
                        p_green <= 0;
                        if(cnt == 3) begin
                            state <= 'd3;
                        end else begin
                            state <= 'd1;
                        end
                    end
                    'd2: begin // s2_yellow
                        p_red <= 0;
                        p_yellow <= 1;
                        p_green <= 0;
                        if(cnt == 3) begin
                            state <= 'd1;
                        end else begin
                            state <= 'd2;
                        end
                    end
                    'd3: begin // s3_green
                        p_red <= 0;
                        p_yellow <= 0;
                        p_green <= 1;
                        if(cnt == 3) begin
                            state <= 'd2;
                        end else begin
                            state <= 'd3;
                        end
                    end
                    default: begin
                        state <= 'd0;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Counting logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 10;
            end else begin
                if(pass_request && green) begin
                    cnt <= 10;
                end else if(!green && p_green) begin
                    cnt <= 60;
                end else if(!yellow && p_yellow) begin
                    cnt <= 5;
                end else if(!red && p_red) begin
                    cnt <= 10;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt - 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Output assignment
        assign clock = cnt;
        
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                red <= 0;
                yellow <= 0;
                green <= 0;
            end else begin
                red <= p_red;
                yellow <= p_yellow;
                green <= p_green;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
    
</module>
